summary: One-frame marker added by ls::TransformSystem::Update for every entity whose translate changed this frame; holds the translate before the first change of the frame. Read by sound, triggers, sight, gravity, spatial grid systems.

fields.name: PreviousTranslate
fields.evidence: ls::TransformSystem::Update (bg3.exe+0x3C77860) walks a map EntityHandle -> 12-byte value at TransformSystem+0x70 (keys +0x90, values +0xA0 stride 0xC) and for each live entity calls the creator bg3.exe+0x3C79320, copying 8+4 bytes into the component. TransformSystem::SetTranslate (GameEngine.dll+0x620930, matched bg3.exe+0x3C78310) inserts the component's old Translate (TransformComponent+0x10) into that map only if the entity is not in it yet. Live: client world coordinates; server values include 0 (fresh entities).
